_note: ENGINE-ERA canonical baseline (rewritten 2026-07-19 for 0.7.6-be.19's two-layer appearance). These are the CANONICAL visualDescriptors — user-owned; the classifier's per-turn appearance tracking now lands on the separate currentVisualDescriptors field and never touches these. They feed identity_tags on every si-bridge render (portraits, sprite anchors, sprite cells, scene specs) and the sprite appearance hash, so the rules are: (1) NO SIZE VOCABULARY in any field — the BE engine's tier is the single size authority (tier_index on the spec path / be_tier_index on the prompt path); band words here would ride identity_tags verbatim into every render and fight the tier at every band. Lucy's size lives in character.metadata.bodyState.tier, seeded via the BE panel. (2) build = frame only — 'curvy' maps onto the bridge's build vocabulary; the tail and species markings live in distinguishing. (3) clothing = the CANONICAL outfit — it rides scene renders as 'Lucy wearing ...' and sprite cells as 'wearing ...'; scene-specific outfits come from the narrative prompt, torn/burst states from be_moments. (4) accessories intentionally omitted (nothing in canon). '_paste_into_editor' is the exact string for the Visual Descriptors textarea (World > Characters > Edit, or the Vault editor — both parse with stringToDescriptors). Underscore-prefixed keys are not part of the schema; strip them for programmatic use.
